items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3 as surge-damaged audio equipment with a diagnostic report; the endorsement waives the 50% reduction and the EUR 5,000 sub-limit is not reached. Priced at standard grade (7.1.9), scaled from reference Case 1 (781-900 for both items after halving, so about 1,560-1,800 in full).
Carriage or delivery of replacement property is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b) and is outside 5.2.2, so t = 0.
Fitting, installing and commissioning replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c), so t = 0.

Covered under 2.3.3 with surge failure confirmed; no halving because of the waiver endorsement, and the total stays within the EUR 5,000 sub-limit. Standard-grade replacement (7.1.9), taken as the larger share of the Case 1 full level of about 1,560-1,800.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: The charge combines property damage with a liability risk and is not separately itemised or priced, so it falls outside cover in its entirety under 3.1.4 and 7.1.8(f); 7.1.10 points the same way.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics - service order
items.rationale: A charge for placing an order under a service or liability arrangement is excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f), so t = 0.
Under 7.1.8(d) an attendance charge is payable only alongside indemnifiable work on the same invoice; nothing on this invoice is indemnifiable, so t = 0.
